newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA deadline passes, 3 bids in - report.
newsitem.headline: CA deadline passes, 3 bids in - report.

text.p: Finance Minister Viktor Klima had received three firm offers for Austria's second biggest bank Creditanstalt by the 0700 GMT deadline on Monday, radio reported.
The nation's biggest bank Bank Austria has publicly declared its interest in taking over the state's 70 percent of Creditanstalt ordinary shares.
It faces competition from a consortium around insurer EA-Generali and savings bank Die Erste Oesterreichische SparCasse (First Austrian).
The identity of the third bidder remained a mystery.
Austrian media speculated it could be a German banking group, General Electric Capital Corp of the United States or even former supermarket boss Karl Wlaschek.
No one at the finance ministry was immediately available for comment.
